visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Nighttime view of a brightly lit Lawson convenience store during a heavy snowstorm. Thick snowflakes fall rapidly, covering the ground and the store's blue and white facade. (2) At the entrance, a female staff member in a striped uniform manually slides open the glass door. A person stands nearby while the snow continues to pile up at the threshold. (3) A dark SUV with a roof rack is parked in the lot, its black paint starkly contrasted against the accumulation of white snow on its roof and the pavement. (4) A young woman in a beige sweater and a long white skirt twirls and dances joyfully in the snow-covered street, her arms outstretched as she smiles at the camera. (5) Several ducks walk across the snowy pavement in front of the store. One duck is captured in a close-up, snapping its beak at the falling snowflakes as if trying to catch them.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 遇到日本10年最冷寒流！連四國都下大雪!!! (2) [Subtitle]: 超商電動門立馬轉手動. (3) [Subtitle]: 台灣長大的我看到雪 真的開心到不行. (4) [Subtitle]: 不知道從哪冒出來的鴨子 超可愛xD. (5) [Subtitle]: 四國的鴨子 似乎也是第一次見到下雪. (6) [Variety]: 我咬！
